title: flc-sample/v1 (Go profile) — caret-based full-line completion sample
description: Go profile of the shared flc-sample/v1 contract. *_byte_offset values are byte offsets into the original file bytes (BOM included) and are the primary, authoritative coordinates: Go tooling (go/token, gopls internals, LSP didChange on disk) uses byte offsets. *_utf16_offset values are UTF-16 code-unit offsets into the decoded text with any UTF-8 BOM removed, provided for IntelliJ/LSP parity (the IDE addresses the document in UTF-16). Lines and columns are zero-based; columns are given in both byte and UTF-16 units. Line breaks are LF or CRLF only (files with a lone CR are rejected at discovery). Invariant: bytes[caret_byte_offset..target_end_byte_offset] == target_text and bytes == bytes[..caret]+target_text+bytes[target_end..]. target_text never contains a line break and excludes trailing whitespace of the line (that whitespace starts right_context). For supervised FLC serialize target_text followed by a dedicated <|eol|> stop token.

revision.description: Full git commit SHA; null when the input is not a git checkout.

relative_path.description: '/'-separated path relative to the repository root.

project.description: Package directory relative to the repo root ('.' for the root), i.e. the Go package the file belongs to.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact original file bytes (BOM included).

line_end_utf16_offset.description: End of line content, excluding the line break.

left_context.description: bytes[left_context_start..caret] as text; at most context.left_chars UTF-16 units; never splits a rune.

right_context.description: bytes[target_end..right_context_end] as text; starts immediately after target_text (trailing whitespace, then the line break if present). Stored for FIM research; not a default model feature.

end_of_line.description: CR/OTHER never occur in the Go profile (lone CR rejected at discovery); kept for schema compatibility.

build_constraint.description: Normalized //go:build expression (or legacy +build) of the file, if any.

build_match.description: Whether the file matches the configured build context (GOOS/GOARCH/tags, cgo disabled). False files still yield syntax samples tagged build_excluded unless discovery.build_excluded_policy=skip.
